plan.understanding: Kestrel Genetic Medicine, a health care provider established in Subregion A1, proposes to send one identified adult patient's genetic test report, ECG summary, identity details and referral letter to Harrow Inherited Cardiac Clinic in Region B. Harrow will review the information for a treatment-related second opinion, conduct one video consultation and retain the referral in its own clinical record. The transfer is a one-off encrypted upload, with no onward transfer proposed. Kestrel relies on health-care processing and the patient's explicit consent for the outward transfer, but there is no approved transfer-clause agreement or documented transfer assessment.
